q: All are common signs of heart failure in children EXCEPT:
e: Oedema is a late sign in infants (eyelids, sacrum).

q: An early manifestation of heart failure in a newborn is:
Signs of heart failure in infancy include all EXCEPT:
e: The liver enlarges, not the spleen.

q: Which is a sign of heart failure in a child?
e: The most reliable sign in infants.
Also hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and heart block.

q: A child on digoxin and furosemide develops vomiting and bradycardia. The most likely contributing factor is:
e: Loop diuretics lower potassium and increase digoxin toxicity.

q: A pale 3-month-old has a heart rate of 270, narrow QRS and no P waves. After vagal manoeuvres fail, give:
The commonest cause of heart failure in infancy is:
o: Congenital heart disease with a left-to-right shunt
